connector.name: Jobero job search
connector.registryDescription: Paid job search: 7 matched roles, each with a tailored CV and cover letter.
connector.summary: Hosted at jobero.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.jobero, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <agent API key>. Optional: get_pricing and register_agent work without one.
